protocol.hyperparameter_source: fixed in advance; no selection on test data
protocol.test_access: two evaluations per arm: before training and at the final step

notes: synthetic grammar corpus: generalization claims are scoped to these families
no held-out document contributes tokens to the training vocabulary
windows never cross a document boundary
manifest.split_algorithm: documents sorted by sha256(f'{split_seed}:{document_id}'); first 80% train, next 10% validation, remaining 10% test

phase16_audit.loss_mask: every real position supervised; padded positions carry target u32::MAX and weight 0
phase16_audit.padding: none at fixture level; the training harness pads short rows with PAD and masks them
phase16_audit.sequence_packing: one contiguous window of 64 tokens per row

split_verdict.reason: the corpus is one generator family of 32 modular arithmetic progressions; every row is a cyclic shift of the same progression, so any partition leaks the held-out distribution and the 100-step schedule reuses each example 25.0x on average
split_verdict.recommendation: keep this fixture frozen for Phase XVI numerical and dispatch qualification; run Phase XVII held-out evaluation on the separate document-level fixture in validation/fixtures/phase17

phase16_audit.tokenization: pretokenized integer ids; no tokenizer is consulted

seed_investigation.finding: dropout is 0.0 for this fixture, dataset order is a deterministic function of the step index, and full-parameter initialization comes from the frozen checkpoint, so the dropout seed changes no input to this experiment; identical trajectories across seeds are therefore not independent replication
seed_investigation.active_randomness_source: training-window order offset, used for the order replication below

limitations: the fixture is a synthetic three-family grammar corpus; the claim is scoped to it

full-parameter AdamW moment tensors are private; the observable optimizer-state digest covers step, learning rate, coefficients and dropout seed, while the interleaved-evaluation control covers the moments behaviourally
the evaluation loss is computed on the host from forward_logits output, not by the training cross-entropy shader
mixed WMMA remains opt-in and the device scope is this AMD RDNA3 machine
no tokenizer beyond the fixture's committed word-level vocabulary was exercised
